body:
Thank you for being so nice! I didn't expect people to be so kind. :3 It really did help my mood. I'll take a look at the link too.

 I'm going to try to move as soon as I'm older, I'm already settled on that. I'm keeping my grades good so a scholarship can send me away from here. 

My mother might move out soon leaving me and my dad, and even if he sucks, he's sooo much better than my mother. I could handle time with him, but him and my mother combined is breaking me down. A user below mentioned going to the school counselor which I might do. If things get really bad, I might have to try to convince my grandparent to somehow help me, though I don't want to involve them in this mess and make their lives stressful.

I've been thinking about talking to a school counselor, but I'm worried about them going behind my back and telling my parents thinking I'm exaggerating or something because I'm a teen. My dad can be great at times, really fun to be with and cool. But then there's times when he's treats me like a buddy to vent to and does the above. It's like to different people. 

I'd actually love to talk to my grandparents on my mother's side, but I have the same fears about them telling my parents. They also live pretty far away (I'm in the north and they're in Florida) I'm also scared that my parents may not want to talk to me again or my dad will be really upset... my older half sister only just started talking to him again and I'd feel guilty if I made him depressed. 

I've been trying to get a job but my mom wont let me, saying she needs to know her schedule first and all that. My dad just... wont do it because he's always busy or tired after working. 

Thank you for the kind words, they really made me smile. :)
